map.输入ANA核型与ENA抗体结果，解释临床意义与相关疾病: Enter ANA pattern and ENA antibody results to interpret clinical significance and related diseases.
map.📖 查看「自身抗体谱(ANA/ENA)结果解释器 使用指南」: View "Autoantibody Panel (ANA/ENA) Result Interpreter User Guide"
map.ANA阳性(>1:80)提示自身免疫病可能，需结合核型和特异性抗体。低效价阳性也: A positive ANA (>1:80) suggests possible autoimmune disease and needs correlation with pattern and specific antibodies. Low-titer positives also occur in healthy people (elderly, infection, tumors). Antibody combinations are more diagnostic than a single antibody.
map.风湿免疫门诊把 ANA 滴度与荧光模式（如均质/斑点）对应，理解筛查阳性意义。: In rheumatology clinics, correlate ANA titer with fluorescence pattern (e.g. homogeneous/speckled) to understand screening-positive meaning.
map.ENA 多项阳性时按条目梳理可能指向的结缔组织病谱。: When multiple ENA are positive, map each item to possible connective-tissue disease spectra.
map.教学演示自身抗体的报告阅读逻辑。: Demonstrate the report-reading logic of autoantibodies in teaching.
map.工具提示 1:320 属中等滴度、斑点型为常见筛查模式，需结合 ENA/dsDN: The tool notes 1:320 is a moderate titer and speckled is a common screening pattern; correlate with ENA/dsDNA and symptoms — do not diagnose lupus on this alone.
map.ANA 阳性就是红斑狼疮吗？: Does a positive ANA mean lupus?
map.不是。低中滴度 ANA 阳性也可见于健康人与其他自身免疫病，确诊需抗体谱+临床+: No. Low-to-moderate ANA positivity also occurs in healthy people and other autoimmune diseases; confirmation needs antibody panel + clinical + biopsy.
map.滴度越高越严重？: Is a higher titer always more severe?
map.滴度提示抗体量但与疾病活动度非简单正相关；动态变化与具体抗体种类更有意义。: Titer indicates antibody amount but is not simply proportional to disease activity; trends and specific antibody types matter more.
map.本工具能出诊断报告吗？: Can this tool issue a diagnostic report?
map.不能，仅做条目解释与复习辅助，最终由免疫科医师判定。: No, it only explains items and aids review; the immunologist makes the final call.
map.关于「自身抗体谱结果解释器」: About the Autoantibody Panel Result Interpreter
map.自身抗体（ANA/ENA/dsDNA 等）滴度与模式结构化提示工具。帮助理解报告: A structured prompt tool for autoantibody (ANA/ENA/dsDNA etc.) titers and patterns. It helps understand report items, needs clinical correlation, and does not replace diagnosis.
